```sql
WITH cust AS (
    SELECT c.id,
           c.email,
           c.company,
           c.country_code
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
),
agg AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents) AS revenue,
           count(*)           AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)  AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
      JOIN cust c ON c.id = o.customer_id
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       a.revenue,
       a.order_count,
       a.last_order_at
  FROM cust c
  JOIN agg  a ON a.customer_id = c.id
 WHERE a.last_order_at >= %(from)s
   AND a.last_order_at <  %(to)s
 ORDER BY a.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De tenantfilter wordt nu toegepast op `customers` vóór de aggregatie, zodat alleen de orders van die tenant worden gegroepeerd, en `DISTINCT ON` is vervangen door `max(created_at)`, wat dezelfde waarde oplevert zonder de volledige sortering. De `MATERIALIZED` CTE is weggehaald, zodat de planner de join en de index op `orders(customer_id)` vrij kan kiezen. Let op: rijen met gelijke `revenue` hebben in het origineel geen vaste onderlinge volgorde, en dat blijft hier ook zo.
